four_fields.mechanism: Freeze per-fold features/parameters/prefix mapping chosen from inner only before outer feedback. Outer outputs are report-only and cannot alter any selection.
four_fields.prediction: Two conflicting outer worlds leave B2/W1 and feature/parameter identity unchanged when inner input is fixed.
four_fields.nearest_finite_experiment: UNRUN paper specification: one fold, two arms/two prefixes, fixed inner winners B2/W1 and two opposed outer tables; compare selector mapping with explicit inner-only table.
four_fields.task1_benefit: Detect outer feedback leakage at the choice boundary while distinguishing conditional fixed-W diagnostics from evaluation of complete feature-search/tuning procedure.

matched_control: Explicit hand-specified inner-only B2/W1 mapping, not an intentionally weak all-data selector.
falsifier: Any changed prefix/features/parameters between outer-table variants, or outer scores supplied to the selector, rejects isolation. No fixture or test executed.
negative_outcome: Reject only proposed implementation evidence; no new current-study gate. Undefined positive-query support remains undefined with no resampling/refill.
